config.description: M15 and H1 EMA structure with the trade, an M5 pullback and momentum back in the trend direction.
config.name: R1: EMA trend pullback (2R)

documentation.data: M5, M15 and H1 closed candles (EMA50 needs 100 bars per timeframe).
documentation.entry: Long when M15 close is above EMA50 and EMA20 is above EMA50, H1 close is above its EMA50, the last M5 swing low is a higher low (pullback) and M5 RSI(14) is at least 50; mirrored for shorts.
documentation.exit: Take-profit at the variant's R multiple; stop at the last unbroken M5 swing (+0.1 ATR buffer); time exit after 120 minutes.
documentation.investigates: Whether gold continues in the direction of an established intraday trend after a pullback.
documentation.limitations: EMAs lag; in ranges the stack flips often. Needs 100+ M15 and H1 candles for EMA50.
documentation.stop_loss: M5 structure stop (ATR 1.5 fallback when no usable swing).

research.chosen_by: higher development expectancy (+0.100 R over 205 trades)

config.description: A fresh M5 break of structure with RSI momentum during London or New York in a normal or expanding volatility regime.
config.name: R2: momentum breakout (2R)

documentation.data: M5 closed candles; session definitions.
documentation.entry: Long when an M5 bullish BOS became known within 2 candles, M5 RSI(14) >= 60, M5 volatility is normal or expanding and London or New York is open; mirrored for shorts (RSI <= 40).
documentation.exit: R-multiple take-profit, 1.5 x ATR(M5) stop, 60-minute time exit.
documentation.investigates: Whether breaks of structure with momentum follow through in liquid sessions.
documentation.limitations: Breakouts often retrace (false breaks); late entries after a 2-candle window.
documentation.stop_loss: 1.5 x ATR(M5) from the entry side.

documentation.entry: Long when H1 structure is ranging, a bullish sweep of sell-side liquidity (equal lows, previous-day or session lows) became known within 6 M5 candles and M5 RSI(14) <= 65; mirrored for shorts.

documentation.data: M5 closed candles with liquidity analysis on M5; H1 structure; session definitions.
documentation.entry: Long when London and New York are both open, a confirmed bullish break (acceptance) of a previous-day or session high became known within 3 M5 candles, M5 RSI(14) >= 55 and H1 structure is not bearish; mirrored for shorts.
